aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When a DTVV is not present, Visa forwards the transaction to the issuer to make the authorization decision without a cryptogram validation result.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Browsers use a three-digit DTVV cryptogram collected by merchants that support CVV2 and sent in the same manner as a CVV2; transactions without a token cryptogram are also supported where the merchant does not collect/submit CVV2.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: For MasterCard Token and Digital Secure Remote Payment (DSRP) cryptogram, use the TAVV cryptogram field in segment 123 instead of UCAF Data.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: The Remote Commerce Acceptor Identifier is applicable only to MasterCard transactions where the merchant is also sending the DSRP or Token Authentication Verification Value (TAVV) data field in segment 123.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Cryptogram Token Data may be sent as 28 bytes (treated as token data block A) or 56 bytes (treated as token data block A and token data block B) in base64 format.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Cryptographic value returned depends on card brand: Visa returns CAVV, MasterCard returns AAV, Amex returns AEVV.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: For Verified-by-Visa only transactions, use CAVV as defined in Table ID: 035 (Verified By Visa Data) of Appendix I; TAVV is not applicable.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: For Digital Wallet (Payment Token) only transactions, use CAVV â€“ Revised Format (Data Element 195); TAVV is not applicable.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: For combined Verified-by-Visa and Digital Wallet transactions, populate both CAVV â€“ Revised Format (Data Element 195) and Digital Wallet Payment Token Cryptogram TAVV (Data Element 237).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Effective October 2018, Visa supports two separate cryptograms in the authorization message: the TAVV Cryptogram for payment token validation and the 3DS CAVV cryptogram for cardholder authentication.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Amex SafeKey transactions from merchants are sent with the indicator 'SK' followed by 56 bytes of SafeKey data in base64 format; when the first 28 bytes are not applicable, they must be space filled.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Merchants participating in Visa Token Service may optionally support the TAVV in combination with 3-D Secure (3DS) CAVV for payment token-based transactions with 3-D Secure.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When both DSRP cryptogram and SecureCode/Identity Check AAV are present in the same request message, the UCAF Security level code (position 1-2) must be '21' (Channel Encrypted).
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: Merchants must use the UCAF data field in Data Segment 111 (table ID 36) for the MasterCard AAV cryptogram, and must use the TAVV field in Segment 123 (Element 237) for all Token and DSRP cryptograms.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: American Express SafeKey is not available for OptBlue merchants.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Token PAN Suffix (Element 197) is returned in the response only if supplied by the authorizer.

aiToTestSolution.aiStatement: When only a Token or DSRP cryptogram is present, populate the Digital Wallet Payment Token Cryptogram (TAVV) in Data Segment 123 Element 237.
aiToTestSolution.testRequirementTitle: Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data and for transactions including MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data.
